chunks.arabic_text: رِجَالُ الْكَشِّيِّ: حَمْدَوَيْهُ بْنُ نَصِيرٍ، عَنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى، عَنِ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جَنَاحٍ، عَن عِدَّةٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا، وَقَالَ الْعُبَيْدِيُّ: حَدَّثَنِي بِهِ أَيْضًا عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ

translations.en: Rijal al-Kashshi: Hamduwayh ibn Nusayr, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Sa'id ibn Janah, from a number of our companions, and al-Ubaydi said: He also narrated this to me from Ibn Abi Umayr

chunks.arabic_text: أَنَّ ابْنَ أَبِي يَعْفُورَ وَمُعَلَّى بْنَ خُنَيْسٍ كَانَا بِالنِّيلِ عَلَى عَهْدِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، فَاخْتَلَفَا فِي ذَبَائِحِ الْيَهُودِ، فَأَكَلَ مُعَلٌّ وَلَمْ يَأْكُلِ ابْنُ أَبِي يَعْفُورَ، فَلَمَّا صَارَا إِلَى أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ أَخْبَرَاهُ، فَرَضِيَ بِفِعْلِ ابْنِ أَبِي يَعْفُورَ وَخَطَأَ الْمُعَلَّ فِي أَكْلِهِ إِيَّاهُ

translations.en: That Ibn Abi Ya'fur and Mu'alla ibn Khunays were at the Nile during the time of Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), and they differed regarding the slaughtered meat of the Jews. Mu'alla ate it, but Ibn Abi Ya'fur did not. When they returned to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), they informed him, and he was pleased with the action of Ibn Abi Ya'fur and rebuked Mu'alla for eating it.

en.summary: This hadith from Rijal al-Kashshi highlights a practical jurisprudential difference between two prominent companions of Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) regarding the consumption of meat slaughtered by Jews. The Imam’s approval of Ibn Abi Ya'fur’s caution and rebuke of Mu'alla ibn Khunays establishes a preference for avoiding their meat, reflecting the Shia scholarly emphasis on strict adherence to ritual purity and the specific rulings on 'People of the Book' during the Imamate era.
en.seo_question: What was the ruling of Imam al-Sadiq regarding eating meat slaughtered by Jews?
